titleEn: Law on the establishment of the Ministry of Inspection

articles.en: The Ministry of Inspection is hereby established under the Royal Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia.
The Ministry of Inspection shall have the competence to lead and manage the inspection sector of the Kingdom of Cambodia.

The Ministry of Inspection shall be led and managed by one Minister, assisted by Secretaries of State and a number of Under-Secretaries of State as necessary.
The Secretaries of State and Under-Secretaries of State shall perform their duties as assigned by the Minister.
Article 4. - The organisation and functioning of the Ministry of Inspection shall be determined by sub-decree.
Laws and legal instruments relating to the inspection sector that are in force shall continue to have effect until re-determined in accordance with the provisions of this Law.

Legal instruments relating to the implementation of the Law on the Establishment of the Ministry of Relations with the National Assembly-Senate and Inspection and the sub-decree on the organisation and functioning of the Ministry of Relations with the National Assembly-Senate and Inspection shall continue to have effect until new legal instruments are adopted in substitution therefor in accordance with the provisions of this Law.
[Illegible in source]

All work and structures, including civil servants, staff, movable and immovable property, of the Ministry of Relations with the National Assembly-Senate and Inspection shall be integrated under the management of the Ministry of Inspection.

Civil servants and staff who are currently serving at the Ministry of Relations with the National Assembly-Senate and Inspection shall continue to perform their roles and duties in accordance with the legal instruments in force prior to the entry into force of this Law until reorganisation and reappointment in accordance with the laws and legal instruments in force.

The Law on the Establishment of the Ministry of Relations with the National Assembly-Senate and Inspection, promulgated by Royal Kram No. NS/RKM/0699/05 dated 17 June 1999, is hereby repealed, and any provisions contrary to this Law shall be considered null and void.

This Law is declared to be urgent.
[Illegible in source: date in the lunar calendar, Buddhist Era 2567]; done at the Royal Palace, 02 October 2023
Royal signature and seal, Norodom Sihamoni, having respectfully submitted to the King for signature; Prime Minister, Samdech Moha Borvor Thipadei Hun Manet
